---
title: "Setup"
---

Finish this before the workshop. If Claude Code already runs on your laptop and `gh auth status` says you are signed in, you are done; skip to step 6 to check the rest.

If something fails, paste the error into Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini and ask how to fix it. Most install errors are a missing dependency, and the chatbot will tell you what to install.

## 1. A paid Claude plan

Claude Code needs a paid plan: **Claude Pro** ($20 per month) is enough for the workshop. If you build with it daily you will reach Pro's usage limits, and **Claude Max** ($100 per month) is the next step. See [claude.com/pricing](https://www.claude.com/pricing). A work Claude Team or Enterprise seat also works.

## 2. GitHub

- [ ] A [GitHub](https://github.com/) account (free)
- [ ] The GitHub CLI: `brew install gh` on macOS, `winget install GitHub.cli` on Windows ([other options](https://cli.github.com/))
- [ ] Sign in: `gh auth login`

The lab uses `gh` to clone the Agent Team Kit.

## 3. VS Code (or the editor you already use)

Download [VS Code](https://code.visualstudio.com/) if you do not have an editor. On Windows, check **Add to PATH** during installation. Open a terminal inside it with **Terminal → New Terminal**.

## 4. Claude Code

In the terminal:

```bash
# macOS
curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash
```

```powershell
# Windows (PowerShell)
irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex
```

Check it, then start it and sign in:

```bash
claude --version
claude
```

Then ask Claude to install anything else you are missing:

> Help me install the following or confirm they are already installed: git, Node.js (LTS), and pnpm.

The first time you run `claude` in VS Code's terminal, it installs the Claude Code extension, which opens Claude's changes in VS Code's diff viewer. If you prefer the Claude desktop app, install it too; [One Engine, Many Surfaces](11-surfaces.qmd) compares them.

## 5. Optional: Supabase and Vercel

Two parts of the workshop (the schema lock and the release pipeline) make more sense with a real database and a real deploy. Free accounts at [Supabase](https://supabase.com/) and [Vercel](https://vercel.com/) are enough. Sign up with your GitHub account. You can follow the workshop without them.

## 6. Optional: other coding agents

If your team uses another agent, install it too; [One Engine, Many Surfaces](11-surfaces.qmd) maps Claude Code's concepts to each.

| Agent | Install (macOS) | Start |
|---|---|---|
| GitHub Copilot CLI | `brew install --cask copilot-cli` | `copilot` |
| OpenAI Codex | `curl -fsSL https://chatgpt.com/codex/install.sh \| sh` | `codex` |
| Google Antigravity CLI | `curl -fsSL https://antigravity.google/cli/install.sh \| bash` | `agy` |

## 7. Check before you arrive

- [ ] `claude` starts and is signed in
- [ ] `gh auth status` shows you are signed in
- [ ] `git --version` and `node --version` both print a version
- [ ] You have a repo to use in the lab: one of your own (commit everything first), or a scratch app made with `npx create-next-app@latest kit-lab`

New to Claude Code? Work through the rest of Start Here, then [Your First Build](04-first-build.qmd).
